meta.description: RustingCraft is a voxel survival game in Rust and Vulkan: start with your fists, earn every ability in 14 skill trees, play alone or with up to 7 friends.

hero.tagline: Start with your fists. Earn everything else.
hero.lede: A block world to mine, build, farm, fish and fight in, alone or with up to seven friends. You start weak, and every ability is earned in fourteen skill trees.

skills.title: Every ability is earned
skills.lede: Any activity gives general XP. Player levels give skill points, a point unlocks a skill tree, and an unlocked skill grows only by doing it. Mine iron to become a better miner; harvest wheat to become a better farmer.
stats: recipes you know at the start
skills.foot: From the design bible. Numbers may be tuned.

world.title: A world in rings
world.lede: The world is infinite, and it gets more dangerous and richer the farther you travel from spawn and the deeper you dig: from the meadows around spawn to frost peaks, and down into the Deep below y = −64.

farm.title: Farm, fish, cook
farm.lede: Till farmland, grow thirteen crops and hope for a golden harvest. Read the water, wait for the bite and win the reel. Cook feasts that buff everyone at the table.

coop.title: Split the work
coop.lede: Solo play runs an integrated server in the same process, the way Minecraft does. Open it to friends, or run a dedicated server on the same code. Skill points are limited, so friends split the roles: the farmer, the smith, the fighter.
stats: code path for solo and servers

fight.title: Danger is readable
fight.lede: Hollows walk at night, bone archers keep their distance and bog slimes split when they die. Every hostile makes a sound when it notices you, and every attack has a wind-up you can see.

bosses.title: Five bosses, five gates
bosses.lede: Summon each boss at its altar with an offering. Its trophy opens the next material tier, from iron to the legendary Hearthforged gear.

graphics.title: Shaders and mods, built in
graphics.lede: Players download shader packs and mods to make block games look better. RustingCraft ships that look by default: clear water with ripples and reflections, glass, a torch that lights the world from your hand, waving plants and hand animations. Four presets from Low to Ultra.
stats: frame p95, streaming at a sprint
graphics.foot: Measured during M1: release build, RTX 3060, headless 1280 × 720, view distance 8.

follow.title: Follow the build
follow.lede: RustingCraft is built in the open, milestone by milestone. Every milestone ends with measured numbers and a capture. English, German and Russian from the start, and about sixty achievements to guide you.

milestones: Spike
The voxel path on the engine: meshed sections, walking, break and place.
World
Terrain, five biomes, caves, ores, trees, streaming, light, day and night, water, saves.
Server
Integrated and dedicated server on one code path, prediction, two players together.
Survive
Items, inventory, crafting with gates, health, hunger, death and graves.
Skills
General XP, levels, points, six trees complete, the skill screen.
Farm and fish
Farmland, four crops, fishing with the reel game, campfire cooking.
Fight
Animals, night mobs, pathfinding, melee, shields, bows, armour.
Craft and tiers
Furnace, smithing, bronze, quality, chests, beds, the hearth.
First boss
The Thornback altar, the fight, trophies and the iron gate.
First nights
From a fresh spawn to Thornback dead, on a dedicated server.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.lede: Pass A builds the core of every system as milestones M0 to M9. Pass B then builds all of each area, and ends with the release.
passBItems: The full world: tiers 2 to 5, all biomes and structures
All 14 skill trees with every perk
13 crops, cooking, alchemy, building and homes
The built-in shader look and animations
Client and dedicated server builds for Linux and Windows

download.title: Download
download.lede: There is no public build yet.
download.body: The first playable build follows milestone M9: one run from a fresh spawn to the first boss dead, on a dedicated server with two players. Release builds are planned for Linux and Windows, as a client and a dedicated server.

devlog.title: Devlog
devlog.lede: One post per milestone: what was built, what it measured and what broke.

server.title: Servers
server.lede: One server, three ways to run it. Solo, co-op and dedicated share the same code.
server.planned: Joining by address works in development builds. Room codes, chat and the server list come later in the plan.
modes: An integrated server runs in the game process with one player and no open port.
Opens the integrated server to the network. Friends join by address and port, or by a 6-character room code through a relay.
The same server code without a window. Run it on a spare machine for up to 8 players.
config: 6 chunks of crops, mobs and fluids around each player
rules: Clients send inputs and requests; the server checks reach, line of sight, tool, tier and rate before anything changes.
Movement is predicted on the client with the same collision code as the server, which corrects it when it is more than 0.25 m off.
A block break that arrives earlier than 80% of the server's own break time is rejected.
Chunks stream nearest first under a byte budget per player: 256 KB/s on a LAN, 96 KB/s over the internet.
Your skills, inventory and position are kept by the server under your player id, so you get them back when you return.
server.adminLede: For the host and listed admin ids only.
